info.title: Vision Describe API
info.description: Vision-language understanding over x402. POST a public image URL (or a data: URL) plus an optional question, and receive a short natural-language answer. Billing is per successful call in USDC, settled on-chain or via Circle Gateway. No API keys, no accounts: the 402 response carries everything needed to pay.

servers.description: Production endpoint (replace with your deployed host)

post.summary: Describe or answer a question about an image
post.description: Paid endpoint. An unpaid request returns 402 Payment Required with a PAYMENT-REQUIRED header listing accepted chains, asset, amount and payTo. A request carrying a valid x402 payment is settled first, then answered.

image.description: Publicly reachable https URL, or a data URL of the form data:image/png;base64,...

prompt.description: Question to ask about the image. Defaults to a general description.

402.description: Payment required. Payment options are in the PAYMENT-REQUIRED response header (base64-encoded JSON).

get.description: Free. Used for continuous health checks after listing.
